_comment: Who holds a GUILD rank. Everyone else you fight shows a THREAT rank instead. Editor IDs are resolved by tools/EspGen against the vanilla masters (a typo fails the build) into adventurers.resolved.json. Order of checks: player -> already recruited -> current teammate (joins on the spot) -> joinOnRecruit exception (no guild rank until recruited) -> members -> chance groups -> none.
_members: Guild members from the start: anyone who can be a follower or hired. Custom followers usually add PotentialFollowerFaction; ones that don't are caught when they first become your teammate.
_named: Named NPCs the Guild has on its books whatever their factions say. npcs = editor IDs (resolved by tools/EspGen). level = the least level they have in game (raised in memory when the game loads, no record is edited), which also sets their rank: 24 is C. retiredWhen = a location, a keyword on it and the value that means they have taken another service (Sinmir is made captain of the guard when the Stormcloaks hold Whiterun: CWOwner 2); until then they are an active member. rank = their Guild rank, fixed whatever their level (followers who level with the player would otherwise drift). note / retiredNote = a line for their SkyrimNet bio.

named.note: A seasoned C-rank adventurer who drinks at the Bannered Mare between jobs and still takes Guild Missives. Proud of his rank and sure he deserves a higher one; talks down to adventurers ranked below him, treats an equal as a rival, and is grudging toward anyone above. Holds the Whiterun guards in open contempt: an adventurer is paid when the job is done.
named.retiredNote: Was a C-rank adventurer until the Stormcloaks made him commander of the Whiterun guard; the Adventurers Guild set his name aside for it, and he insists that was the Guild's loss. Still judges people by their Guild rank, and runs the watch the way an adventurer would.

named.note: A D-rank adventurer who drinks at the Bannered Mare. The Companions turned her away after she killed a recruit in her trial, and she took her blade to the Adventurers Guild instead; she is proud of earning her rank on her own and bitter about Jorrvaskr. Hard, blunt and always ready for a brawl. Sinmir, a rank above her, gets on her nerves.

A B-rank adventurer who roamed Tamriel for years before a Dwemer ruin cost her blade and nearly her life. She has not taken a missive in years and now gives herself to cleaning up Riften, but the Adventurers Guild keeps her name on its books and she is proud to be a member. Warm and encouraging to newer adventurers, level with her equals, glad to see anyone surpass her.

A D-rank scout of the Adventurers Guild who found the ore vein Darkwater Crossing was built on. She settled down when she married Verner, still carries her guild card, and misses the road more than she admits to him.

_joinOnRecruit: Followers whose story makes guild membership unlikely until they travel with you. They register when first recruited.

joinOnRecruit._npcs: Named NPCs treated the same way (Erik the Slayer is for hire, but only becomes an adventurer when the player takes him along).

_chance: Random world NPCs. The roll is a hash of the reference's FormID, so the same NPC always gets the same answer (no save data). kind: member = '(C)', retired = '(C, retired)', hidden = rank kept secret (only high Appraisal reveals it). First matching group wins.
